correctness.rationale: Verified every essential inference. X* smooth via monomial partials (4x0^3,8x1^3,-20x2^3,-40x3^3) vanishing only at origin; smooth quartic in P^3 integral via G-H intersection argument, so k(X*) field and f nonzero (Qbar-point x0=1,x1=x3=0,x2^4=1/5 gives f=1). Purity reduces Br(X) membership to vanishing of all residues. Constant-b residue formula d_D((f,b))=[b^{v_D(f)}] for v odd gives [b] verified against Gille-Szamuely 6.8.3-6.8.4; sign factor trivial since v(g)=0. Over K=Q(sqrt(-2)) divisor D+=V(x0-alpha x1) cap X*_K proved irreducible prime divisor via explicit isomorphism to smooth plane quartic C0:6y1^4-5y2^4-10y3^4=0 ([x0:x1:x2:x3]->[x1:x2:x3] with inverse [y]->[alpha y1:y1:y2:y3]); C0 smooth (nonzero coeffs) hence geometrically integral via Bezout meeting implies singular argument; base-change preserves smoothness. Transverse Qbar-point p (x0=alpha,x1=1,x2=t with 5t^4=6,x3=0) lies on both X* (4+2-6=0) and H+ with gradients (4alpha^3,-20t^3,0) vs (1,0,0) linearly independent since t!=0; hence h+ is regular parameter, (h+) is height-1 prime, v_{D+}(h+)=1 while h-=2alpha!=0 and x2=t!=0 are units, so v_{D+}(f)=1 odd. Residue is [-10]=[5] since (x0/x1)^2=-2 makes [-2]=0 in K(D+). Lemma 5 not in K^2 proved elementarily: (a+b sqrt(-2))^2=5 forces a^2-2b^2=5,2ab=0; a=0 gives -2b^2=5 impossible (<=0<5), b=0 gives a^2=5 impossible via mod-5 squares {0,1,4} implying 5|p^2=>5|p plus descent. Lift to function field via proper geometrically integral => H^0=K*, so u^2=5 implies div(u)=0 => u in K*, contradiction; hence residue nonzero. Thus (f,b)_K ramified, not in Br(X*_K). Descent via pi:X*_K->X*_Q pullback compatibility (Azumaya pullback, same symbol) gives contrapositive: unramified over Q would pull back unramified, so (f,b)_Q not in Br(X*_Q). Hence conjunction requiring A in Br(X*)[2] false. Exact stdlib verify.py replayed independently -> VERIFY_OK. Proof distinguished from experiment: computation only checks integer identities and mod-5 residues; all valuations/divisor arguments are proofs.
